只有写完作业，才能看电视。 (Zhǐyǒu xiě wán zuòyè, cái néng kàn diànshì.) - Only after finishing your homework can you watch TV.
只有妈妈做的饭，她才爱吃。 (Zhǐyǒu māma zuò de fàn, tā cái ài chī.) - She only likes to eat the food that Mum cooks.
只有爸爸、妈妈才能分出来。 (Zhǐyǒu bàba, māma cái néng fēn chūlái.) - Only Dad and Mum can tell them apart.
看来只有爱，才能让人有变化。 (Kànlái zhǐyǒu ài, cái néng ràng rén yǒu biànhuà.) - It seems that only love can make people change.
你怎么学得这么认真？ (Nǐ zěnme xué de zhème rènzhēn?) - Why do you study so earnestly?
最近你怎么吃得越来越少？ (Zuìjìn nǐ zěnme chī de yuèláiyuè shǎo?) - Why have you been eating less and less lately?
你怎么又出去锻炼啊？ (Nǐ zěnme yòu chūqù duànliàn a?) - Why are you going out to exercise again?
中国在东边。 (Zhōngguó zài dōngbian.) - China is in the east.
公司东门外不就有一个大商场吗？ (Gōngsī dōngmén wài bú jiù yǒu yí ge dà shāngchǎng ma?) - Isn't there a big shopping mall outside the east gate of the company?
他一直都很关心我。 (Tā yìzhí dōu hěn guānxīn wǒ.) - He has always cared about me.
你怎么突然关心起体育来了？ (Nǐ zěnme tūrán guānxīn qǐ tǐyù lái le?) - Why have you suddenly become interested in sports?
你是怎么提高历史成绩的？ (Nǐ shì zěnme tígāo lìshǐ chéngjì de?) - How did you improve your history grades?
我的成绩差极了。 (Wǒ de chéngjì chà jí le.) - My grades are extremely poor.
多么难的问题，都会被解决的。 (Duōme nán de wèntí, dōu huì bèi jiějué de.) - No matter how difficult the problem is, it will be solved.
有些问题得试着做做。 (Yǒuxiē wèntí děi shìzhe zuòzuo.) - Some problems have to be tried out.
你每个月花多少钱？ (Nǐ měi ge yuè huā duōshao qián?) - How much money do you spend each month?
你想要什么结婚礼物？ (Nǐ xiǎng yào shénme jiéhūn lǐwù?) - What wedding present do you want?
他怎么又看篮球比赛了？ (Tā zěnme yòu kàn lánqiú bǐsài le?) - Why is he watching a basketball match again?
我的电脑又坏了。 (Wǒ de diànnǎo yòu huài le.) - My computer is broken again.
你觉得周经理怎么样？ (Nǐ juéde Zhōu jīnglǐ zěnmeyàng?) - What do you think of Manager Zhou?
请问，去中国银行怎么走？ (Qǐngwèn, qù Zhōngguó Yínháng zěnme zǒu?) - Excuse me, how do I get to the Bank of China?
把你的手机借给我，我玩儿会儿游戏。 (Bǎ nǐ de shǒujī jiè gěi wǒ, wǒ wánr huìr yóuxì.) - Lend me your mobile phone; I want to play a game for a while.
考试以前不能玩儿了吧？ (Kǎoshì yǐqián bù néng wánr le ba?) - You can't play before the exam, right?
妈妈，我那件白色的衣服呢？ (Māma, wǒ nà jiàn báisè de yīfu ne?) - Mum, where is that white piece of clothing of mine?
你今天要穿吗？ (Nǐ jīntiān yào chuān ma?) - Are you going to wear it today?
你穿那件红色的也很好看。 (Nǐ chuān nà jiàn hóngsè de yě hěn hǎokàn.) - You look nice in that red one too.
你的信用卡呢？ (Nǐ de xìnyòngkǎ ne?) - Where is your credit card?
孩子拿走你的信用卡，你不担心啊？ (Háizi názǒu nǐ de xìnyòngkǎ, nǐ bù dānxīn a?) - Your child took your credit card away; aren't you worried?
快到春节了，你不想出去旅游吗？ (Kuài dào Chūnjié le, nǐ bù xiǎng chūqù lǚyóu ma?) - The Spring Festival is coming soon; don't you want to go travelling?
现在飞机票很贵吧？ (Xiànzài fēijīpiào hěn guì ba?) - Plane tickets are expensive now, aren't they?
小丽找不到什么了？ (Xiǎolì zhǎo bu dào shénme le?) - What can Xiaoli not find?
小丽现在能买一个新的吗？为什么？ (Xiǎolì xiànzài néng mǎi yí ge xīn de ma? Wèi shénme?) - Can Xiaoli buy a new one now? Why?
小明朋友的成绩为什么很差？ (Xiǎomíng péngyou de chéngjì wèi shénme hěn chà?) - Why are Xiaoming's friend's grades so poor?
大卫和他哥哥有什么相同的地方？ (Dàwèi hé tā gēge yǒu shénme xiāngtóng de dìfang?) - What do David and his elder brother have in common?
年轻人遇到难题时应该怎么办？ (Niánqīng rén yùdào nántí shí yīnggāi zěnme bàn?) - What should young people do when they run into difficult problems?
我们在解决问题时要相信什么？ (Wǒmen zài jiějué wèntí shí yào xiāngxìn shénme?) - What should we believe in when solving problems?
只有马可参加，红队才能拿第一名。 (Zhǐyǒu Mǎkě cānjiā, hóng duì cái néng ná dì-yī míng.) - Only if Marco takes part can the red team win first place.

有一天，我去超市买了很多东西，到了家门口，才发现东西被我忘在超市了。 (Yǒu yì tiān, wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi le hěn duō dōngxi, dào le jiā ménkǒu, cái fāxiàn dōngxi bèi wǒ wàng zài chāoshì le.) - One day I went to the supermarket and bought a lot of things; only when I reached the door of my home did I discover that I had left the things in the supermarket.
东西被他忘在超市了。 (Dōngxi bèi tā wàng zài chāoshì le.) - He left his things in the supermarket.
车到山前必有路。 (Chē dào shān qián bì yǒu lù.) - The cart will find its way round the hill when it gets there.
"车到山前必有路"，这里"必"是"一定"的意思。 ("Chē dào shān qián bì yǒu lù", zhèlǐ "bì" shì "yídìng" de yìsi.) - In the saying "车到山前必有路", "必" means "surely".

这句话的意思是，车开到了山下，虽然山拦住了车的去路，但是一定会有办法找到出路的。 (Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì, chē kāi dào le shān xià, suīrán shān lánzhù le chē de qùlù, dànshì yídìng huì yǒu bànfǎ zhǎodào chūlù de.) - The saying means that when a vehicle arrives at the foot of a mountain, although the mountain blocks its way, there is surely a way to find a way out.

这句话常用来比喻虽然遇到了问题和困难，但是总会有解决困难的办法。 (Zhè jù huà cháng yòng lái bǐyù suīrán yùdào le wèntí hé kùnnan, dànshì zǒng huì yǒu jiějué kùnnan de bànfǎ.) - This saying is often used metaphorically: although we meet problems and difficulties, there is always a way to solve them.
去别人家做客，要带点儿礼物，但不是什么礼物都能送。 (Qù biérén jiā zuò kè, yào dài diǎnr lǐwù, dàn bú shì shénme lǐwù dōu néng sòng.) - When visiting someone's home you should bring a gift, but not every gift is appropriate.

在中国，有一些东西不能当作礼物送给别人，比如：伞、鞋、钟表等等。 (Zài Zhōngguó, yǒu yìxiē dōngxi bù néng dàngzuò lǐwù sòng gěi biérén, bǐrú: sǎn, xié, zhōngbiǎo děngděng.) - In China, some things cannot be given to others as gifts, such as umbrellas, shoes and clocks.

伞的发音跟“散”差不多，送伞就表示分离的意思。 (Sǎn de fāyīn gēn “sàn” chàbuduō, sòng sǎn jiù biǎoshì fēnlí de yìsi.) - The pronunciation of 伞 (umbrella) is similar to that of 散 (separation), so giving an umbrella means separation.
“鞋”与“邪”的发音相同，有倒霉的意思。 (“Xié” yǔ “xié” de fāyīn xiāngtóng, yǒu dǎoméi de yìsi.) - 鞋 (shoe) sounds the same as 邪 (evil), which means bad luck.

“送钟”与“送终”发音相同，有将去世之人送走的意思。 (“Sòng zhōng” yǔ “sòng zhōng” fāyīn xiāngtóng, yǒu jiāng qùshì zhī rén sòngzǒu de yìsi.) - Giving a clock (送钟) sounds exactly the same as attending upon a dying person (送终), implying seeing off a person who has passed away.
在你们国家，送礼物有什么禁忌吗？ (Zài nǐmen guójiā, sòng lǐwù yǒu shénme jìnjì ma?) - What taboos do you have in your country regarding giving gifts?
